Title: Immich
Description: Self-hosted photo and video backup with machine learning search.
Note: Set DB_PASSWORD, UPLOAD_LOCATION, DB_DATA_LOCATION, DB_USERNAME, DB_DATABASE_NAME, and IMMICH_VERSION when deploying the stack. Exposes Immich on port 2283.

Title: Caddy
Description: Simple reverse proxy and static file server.
Note: Publishes ports 80 and 443. Configure local DNS records for app hostnames before using hostname-based routes.

Title: Glance
Description: Self-hosted personal dashboard with RSS, videos, weather, markets, releases, and community widgets.
Note: Uses the Glance config committed under apps/glance/config. Exposes the dashboard on port 8080.
